phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Capacitive soil moisture sensor probe integrated with a microcontroller unit (MCU) and wireless radio communication module, designed for real-time soil moisture monitoring in agricultural applications.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This form is the industry-standard solution as of 2024 for precise, low-power soil moisture sensing with embedded processing (MCU) and wireless data transmission (radio), enabling scalable IoT agriculture networks. Capacitive sensors dominate due to their durability and accuracy over resistive types, and integration of MCU with radio is common to minimize system size and optimize power use.
